जैत्र जैत्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. rt. 1. जि), victorious,
triumphant, leading to victory, overcoming, surpass-
ing, superior; (अस्), m. a conqueror, victor; N. of a
son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; (ई), f. the plant Sesbania
Ægyptiaca; (अम्), n. victory, triumph, superiority.
—जैत्र-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a triumphant
car; (अस्), m. a victor, a conqueror, a hero; a
triumphant car.
जैत्रायणि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Jaitra.
